author: moilmo
quote: This game is a complete scam. This isn't Grand Theft Auto—it’s Girlfriend-Tamed Amateur. It’s a woke Dating Sim and Construction Simulator disguised as a GTA game. If I wanted to play a domestic life and house-building sim, I wouldn’t have dropped $100 on it—let alone get forced to switch from my PC to a PS5 just to play this garbage at launch, which wasn't worth it at all. Gabe Newell once said in an interview that people play games to have fun and feel good, not to be handed a boring grocery list of chores—and Rockstar completely forgot that. I’m focusing mostly on Chapter 1 here to avoid major spoilers, and it is an absolute snoozefest that drags on forever, forcing you into tedious relationship micromanagement instead of actual crime and freedom.They completely killed the core spirit of the franchise since the very first game. The classic GTA spirit was running around shirtless in your boxers and pulling a whole RPG straight out of your underwear—now they ditched that fun arcade soul just to lazily copy Red Dead’s realism. Don't get me wrong, I loved Red Dead; its atmosphere and tone were great, and it was a phenomenal game. But Grand Theft Auto should never turn into Red Dead—they are two completely different franchises. If CD Projekt Red managed to keep The Witcher and Cyberpunk completely distinct from one another, it's pathetic that a giant like Rockstar, with all their massive budget, couldn't separate the identities of their own two flagship **** title is literally Grand Theft Auto, yet when you steal a car and try to store it in your garage, the game blocks you because "it's a stolen vehicle." Even the main storyline completely abandons the classic GTA themes and satirical edge we loved in previous entries. On top of that, woke identity politics ruined the sandbox freedom by making certain ideologically "protected" NPCs completely immune to damage. And the character writing is an absolute joke: your protagonist is built like an absolute tank who looks intimidating as hell, yet he’s calling his girlfriend crying for help because a random woman is chasing him. Even worse, when his partner leaves their kid unattended and you confront it, instead of getting rightfully angry, he completely brushes it off and says, "I'm **** happy." What kind of pathetic writing is that?Technically, it’s a broken mess—riddled with constant bugs, frequent crashes, and severe FPS dips into the low 20s during gameplay. This is completely unacceptable for a supposed "5-A" game in 2026 with a $2 billion budget and 13 years of development time. And don't fall for the bought-and-paid-for Metacritic reviews—critics literally admit in their own text that the game is incomplete and flawed, yet still hand it a 100/100 score. Top it all off with a rushed, unsatisfying finale where the decent outcomes are locked behind tedious money grinding. Total letdown.
